The Dayton International Airport once ranked among the nation's busiest [[air freight]] facilities and was the Midwestern hub for [[Emery Worldwide]], a [[Consolidated Freightways|CF]] company. Emery, which was then operating under the name Menlo Worldwide Forwarding, was acquired by [[United Parcel Service]] (UPS) at the end of 2004. UPS closed the facility on June 30, 2006, moving operations to [[Worldport (UPS air hub)|Worldport]] at [[Louisville International Airport]].
